title: Bug: search cannot find a document I renamed
objective: Bug report from Tom: "I renamed 'Pricing Sheet' to 'Rate Card 2027'. Searching for 'rate' finds nothing, but searching for 'pricing' still shows it, under its new name." Find the cause and fix it for the library page search and the documents API, with a regression test. Search's existing behaviour (matching, order, archived and deleted documents) must not change.
acceptance: A renamed document is found by its new title, in title order, on the page and the API
Its old title no longer finds it
Created, archived, unarchived and deleted documents still keep search current
plan_summary: Rename emits a document event the search index listens to; a regression test.
